checks.detail: the reply calls it a page, or doesn't call it the app

answer:
I added a page to your "Porto weekend" note. It shows the next 5 days of weather for Porto, and I haven't been able to run it, so it's untested. For each day it shows the high and low, an icon, a short description and the chance of rain. Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays are highlighted, and there's a Refresh button. Your note text hasn't changed.

**You need to add an API key before it will load.** You don't have one set up yet. Get a free key at openweathermap.org, then add it in Amber Notes under Settings › API Keys with the name **OpenWeather**. You'll also be asked to approve the api.openweathermap.org host the first time the page loads.

OpenWeather's 5-day forecast only covers the next 5 days, which end around 10 October. Your trip on 16–18 October won't show up until about 11 October. Until then the page shows the coming weekend, not the trip.
